Name: Platonic's Exotic Stuff
Author: Macskasajt
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]I actually started working on this mod back in early 2019, when I had absolutely zero experience about modding. While I was searching through my files, I accidentally found some of these textures and I thought why not? :D

Although I tried to not make duplicate fruits, since then a few new mods came out obviously, so if you're playing with a mod which has the same fruits as mine, those ones will be disabled.

Currently, this mod adds 88 fruits total. There are 77 trees, 10 field crops, and 1 forageable fruit.[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][u][size=6][center]Trees:[/center][/size][/u]

Plans for the future:

- Balancing if needed
- New sprites for trees
[s]- New/reworked textures for some of the fruits[/s] (fixed in v1.1)
- Recipes (For the Platonic's Recipes mod, the first 25 fruits have recipes)
[s]- Maybe compatibility with some machine mods?[/s] (With some machines from AV it is already compatible)
- More fruits
